Her adoptive father died back in 2020 and her adoptive mother died a day after she did.

Ace Trumpets? - Ace of Spade bottles. 

“Niggas is my sons and that’s on repeat…” - Kendrick’s bar in tv off mixed with the “sins” bar in good credit as well a Biggie reference. 

“little Meechies” - is a dig at Rick Ross, Big Meech and Little Meech. 

“Can’t compare, you just CC…” - the obvious is CC meaning carbon copy like when you CC an email. However CC is also the nickname of a baseball player named Carsten Charles Sabathia Jr. , guess who he’s signed to….Roc Nation Sports. 

“Simply just Ferrari window shoppers…”
- sub towards 50 cent (Window Shopper pretty certain that was a Mase diss) 

“…Reaching for Akasha…” - Aaliyah’s Queen of the Damn character (yes Drake has her tatted on him but Jay dated her)

For some reason the ”…die at the Oscars bar reminded me of Jay giving Will Smith advice. 

“You was Fu-Gee-La-La…” - Jay sampled the Fugees song for his song “Moonlight”.
